text:
A white platform or workbench top occupies the lower left half of the frame, photographed from above at an angle; behind and around it is a grey tiled floor with white grout dots.

The platform surface has various machined features: two long recessed slots at left, several small drilled holes, two oval/circular recessed ports near the top edge, and three raised square pedestals with round tops (one mid-right, one lower-centre, one right).

Standing upright on the square pedestal at centre-left is a small cylindrical container, dark grey/black in body, with a narrow light blue conical tip or nozzle at the top; it appears uncapped. No liquid contents are visible inside it.
